summary: A Dubai advocates firm founded in 2012 appears to lose client trust to a free builder address, a 2017 footer and raw page labels.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address and banner make a law firm look temporary to corporate clients.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.cost: An old year suggests the firm is not active online.
findings.fix: A footer that updates by itself.

findings.problem: Raw labels such as practice_areas and our_vision appear in the page text.
findings.cost: Code labels make the page look unfinished.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, only a phone, a fax number and a form.
findings.cost: Many clients message first and call later.
findings.fix: WhatsApp and a short enquiry form with matter type.
